title: tc-icon-swap
description: One icon turning into the next – rotate, scale and blur – by `state`, optionally turning back after a while.

state.description: The icon to show: the `data-state` of one of its icons; unset, or unknown, shows the first

rest.description: The resting state `revert-after` goes back to; by default the first icon's

revertAfter.description: Go back to the resting state this many ms after a change away from it; 0 never does

announce.description: Read each change's word out politely – the icon's `data-label`, else its state
